content.title: 'Euphoria' season 3 episode 1 release date: what time will the Zendaya-led TV show return on HBO Max?
content.text: When you buy through links on our articles, Future and its syndication partners may earn a commission.Will HBO Max *ahem* Rue the day that it didn't make season 3 earlier?. | Credit: Patrick Wymore/HBOAfter a four-year hiatus, Euphoria is set to return to our screens. The multi-award-winning drama, which catapulted the likes of Zendaya, Sydney Sweeney, and Jacob Elordi into the spotlight, is back for its third season. And, despite early negative reviews suggesting it's an "unhinged disaster", I imagine you'll still want to know when its first episode will be released.Below, I'll tell you everything you need to know about Euphoria season 3's premiere date and launch time, where you can watch it, and when future episodes will be released. So, don't, *ahem*, Rue your chance to learn more about Euphoria season 3 episode 1's impending debut.What day does Euphoria season 3 episode 1 come out?Euphoria's third season will make its bow on Sunday, April 12, in North and South America, and Monday, April 13, everywhere else.In the US, season 3 episode 1 is confirmed to air at 9pm ET / 6pm PT on the aforementioned date. Armed with that information, we can work out when it'll drop in other nations, so read on to learn when it'll premiere where you live:US — Sunday, April 12 at 9pm ET / 6pm PTCanada — Sunday, April 12 at 9pm ET / 6pm PTUK — Monday, April 13 at 1am BSTIndia — Monday, April 13 at 6:30am BSTSingapore — Monday, April 13 at 9am BSTAustralia — Monday, April 13 at 11am BSTNew Zealand — Monday, April 13 at 1pm BSTWhere can I watch Euphoria season 3?Sydney Sweeney returns as Cassie in Euphoria season 3 | Credit: HBOIn the US, Euphoria's long-awaited third season will be available on cable network HBO and HBO Max, aka one of the world's best streaming services. It'll also land on the latter in countries where that platform has launched, such as the UK and Australia.For those who don't have access to HBO Max because a) it hasn't launched where you live or b) because you haven't signed up yet, don't worry. Euphoria season 3 is set to come out on other streaming services, so read on to see which one you need to tune into:US — HBO and HBO MaxCanada — CraveUK — HBO Max, Sky Atlantic, and Now TVIndia — JioCinemaSingapore — HBO GoAustralia — HBO MaxNew Zealand — NeonWhen will new episodes of Euphoria season 3 be released?Jacob Elordi's Nate is also part of this season's cast | Credit: Patrick Wymore/HBOLike most HBO TV Originals, new chapters of Euphoria season 3 will drop every Sunday in North and South America, and every Monday in other territories. That'll be the case until its eighth and final episode airs on May 31 / June 1.Want to know when each entry will drop on a streaming platform near you?
